message: There’s something cozy about a power outage that turns into a mini adventure! I love lighting up our living room with a camping lantern and making shadow puppets on the walls while the kids giggle. It’s a fun reminder that sometimes, the best moments come from unexpected situations. What’s your favorite way to keep the fun alive during a blackout? 🌟
scene: a cozy living room lit by a single camping lantern in the evening (golden-hour light through a window)
